# eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves the security groups available to Eon in a region of a restore account. Use this data source to select `security_group_ids` for `eon_restore_job` network settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List the security groups available to Eon in a restore account region
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups" "demo" {
  restore_account_id = eon_restore_account.aws_disaster_recovery.id
  region             = "us-east-1"
}

# Example: Narrow security groups to a specific VPC
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups" "vpc_scoped" {
  restore_account_id = eon_restore_account.aws_disaster_recovery.id
  region             = "us-east-1"
  vpc_id             = "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"
}

output "security_group_ids" {
  description = "IDs of the security groups available for restore in the region"
  value       = [for sg in data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups.demo.security_groups : sg.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Region where the security groups are located.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.

### Optional

- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet to filter security groups by.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC to filter security groups by.

### Read-Only

- `security_groups` (Attributes List) List of security groups available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the security group.
- `name` (String) Name of the security group.
- `vpc` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the VPC the security group is in.
